'''''Enchanting Lure''''' was the name of a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was made available during the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Festival of Love]]. It depicted a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Entertainer|dancing]] inside a house. In the background, another painting titled [[Ewok Festival of Love (painting)|''Ewok Festival of Love'']] could be seen hanging on the wall.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Enchanting Lure'' was a painting in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
